_about: Scene tags Lunelis can suggest. Copy this file to scene_labels.json in the Lunelis data folder to add, change or remove labels (same name replaces a built-in; "off": true removes one). name: the tag, under Scene (Scene > Beach). prompt: what the model looks for, in plain words.

labels.name: Ocean
labels.prompt: a photo of the open sea

labels.name: Snow
labels.prompt: a photo of snow and winter

labels.name: Sunset
labels.prompt: a photo of a sunset or sunrise

labels.name: Night sky
labels.prompt: a photo of stars in the night sky

labels.name: Aurora
labels.prompt: a photo of the northern lights

labels.name: City

labels.name: City at night
labels.prompt: a photo of a city at night

labels.name: Interior

labels.name: Portrait
